description: The Map of Recycling Points is an interactive map on Hong Kong's government waste reduction website that shows where residents can hand in recyclables. The page read on 2026-09-28 explains searching by current location, map area, full text or advanced filters, and groups points into recycling stations and stores, street corner recycling shops, recycling spots, smart recycling bins, recycling bins in public places, and NGO and private collection points. Each point can be filtered by the materials it accepts, including paper, metals, plastics and plastic bottles, glass bottles, fluorescent lamps, rechargeable batteries, small and regulated electrical equipment, clothes, beverage cartons and food waste. The same website links a directory of collectors and recyclers and a list of construction and demolition material recyclers. Coverage is the Hong Kong SAR. Access is free as a web map; no export or licence was seen, and the operating department is inferred from the government waste reduction site, not read on the page. Caveats: point attributes such as opening hours or capacity were not inspected. It supports waste service capacity studies, such as mapping walking access to food waste and electrical equipment collection points across districts. No related Hong Kong waste record is catalogued.
